CLASSIC LEGO SPACE (1978-1987) — yellow-torso astronaut suits, white air-tank backpacks, trans-blue cockpit canopies, friendly Earth-fleet explorer motif; vehicle_class auto-aligns to Classic Space cruiser or rover variant.

BLACKTRON I (1987-1990) — black-with-neon-yellow antagonist suits, wedge-hull ship silhouettes, cockpit-eject modules, aggressive rival-faction aesthetic; vehicle_class becomes Blacktron I wedge-fighter or carrier variant.

ICE PLANET 2002 (1993) — white-and-neon-orange explorer suits, ice-saw-blade equipment, trans-neon-orange crystal accent pieces, arctic-station motif; vehicle_class becomes Ice Planet 2002 drill-rover or ice-hopper variant.

SPACE POLICE I (1989-1991) — white-and-blue cop-force suits, trans-blue visors, prisoner-cell cargo bays, anti-grav cruiser pursuit motif; vehicle_class becomes Space Police I patrol-cruiser or prisoner-transport variant.

M-TRON (1990-1991) — red-and-black suits with magnet-coupling insignia, lime-green accent trim, every vehicle features magnet-dock hardpoint; vehicle_class becomes M-Tron magnet-cargo-cruiser or magnet-crane-shuttle variant.

INSECTOIDS (1998) — purple-and-green organic-alien faction suits, bug-compound-eye helmet visors, trans-purple wing-panels, alien-flora prop clusters; vehicle_class becomes Insectoids bio-fighter or hive-crawler variant.

UNITRON (1994) — blue-and-white friendly-explorer suits, mecha-walker and cruiser build variants, Classic-Space-cousin heritage palette; vehicle_class becomes Unitron command-mecha or Unitron patrol-cruiser variant.

TINTIN DESTINATION MOON (1953 HERGÉ) — red-and-white checkered retro rocket, bubble-helmet astronauts, analogue-dial cockpit props, 1950s bande-dessinée comic canon; vehicle_class becomes Tintin retro-lander or checkered-rocket variant.

GALAXY SQUAD (2013) — orange-and-cyan modular-fighter suits, bug-alien rival faction props, ship-split-in-half detach mechanic; vehicle_class becomes Galaxy Squad split-ship interceptor or bug-catcher-pod variant.

CLASSIC LEGO SPACE MOON BASE — yellow-and-grey astronaut suits, modular grey baseplate construction, trans-blue dome canopies, friendly Earth-fleet surface-ops aesthetic; vehicle_class becomes Classic Space lunar-base or moon-buggy variant.

MARS MISSION (2007) — white-orange-grey Earth-astronaut suits vs grey Martian-alien faction with trans-orange glowing orbs, dueling-faction motif; vehicle_class becomes Mars Mission drilling-rig or alien-interceptor variant.

2001 A SPACE ODYSSEY — minimalist all-white spacesuits, mirror-gold visor helmets, sterile Discovery-One corridor aesthetic, Kubrick-canon monolith props; vehicle_class aligns to Discovery One centrifuge-habitat or EVA-pod variant.

BLACKTRON II (1991-1993) — refreshed black-and-yellow antagonist suits, extending-wing ship profiles, more aggressive wedge silhouettes than Blacktron I; vehicle_class becomes Blacktron II wing-fighter or stealth-cruiser variant.

SPACE POLICE III (2009-2010) — chrome-blue suits with neon highlights, aggressive pursuit-vehicle hardware, updated antagonist-capture equipment; vehicle_class becomes Space Police III pursuit-cruiser or containment-hauler variant.

FOUNDATION GENETIC DYNASTY (APPLE/ASIMOV) — Empire-purple imperial-officer uniforms, ornate Galactic-Empire regalia, Trantor-palace architecture motif; vehicle_class becomes Imperial Foundation-dreadnought or Empire-cruiser ceremonial variant.

ICE PLANET 2002 OUTPOST — white-and-orange cold-environment suits, ice-saw and ice-drill equipment, trans-neon-orange comms-aerial crystal pieces, arctic-base build motif; vehicle_class becomes Ice Planet outpost-station or cold-terrain-lander variant.

APOLLO 1960s NASA REAL-HISTORICAL — historically-accurate A7L white pressure-suits, Saturn-V launch-pad infrastructure, Mission-Control amber-screen consoles, NASA-patch insignia; vehicle_class aligns to Saturn-V stack or Apollo CSM-LM variant.

CLASSIC LEGO SPACE (1978-1987) ROVER EXPEDITION — yellow-torso crew in bubble-helmet variants, open-frame lunar-rover chassis, trans-blue windscreen, exploration-flag props; vehicle_class becomes Classic Space six-wheel surface rover.

ICE PLANET 2002 OUTPOST VARIANT — white-orange crew manning fixed ice-planet surface station, ice-saw turrets, trans-orange beacon towers, arctic-shelter build motif; vehicle_class becomes Ice Planet surface-outpost or ice-buggy.

CLASSIC LEGO SPACE (1978-1987) MOONBASE COMMAND — yellow-torso crew operating modular grey moonbase units, trans-blue dome windows, radar-dish arrays, friendly-explorer command-post aesthetic; vehicle_class becomes Classic Space moonbase-hub or landing-pad module.
TINTIN DESTINATION MOON RETRO — red-and-white checkered retro-rocket astronauts with bubble-helmet visors, 1950s Hergé comic canon prop set; vehicle_class becomes Tintin-style retro moon-lander.

CLASSIC LEGO SPACE LUNAR BASE — grey-and-yellow astronaut suits operating ground-level base modules, trans-blue dome canopies, airlock-connector motifs; vehicle_class becomes Classic Space surface-base or moon-buggy variant.

FOUNDATION GENETIC DYNASTY — Empire-purple ornate imperial-officer uniforms with galactic-throne-room props, Foundation-cream rebellious-scientist contrast attire; vehicle_class becomes Imperial Foundation-cruiser or planet-hopper.

CLASSIC LEGO SPACE DEEP PATROL — white-and-grey long-range astronaut suits, extended-fuel-pod ship geometry, deep-space antenna array props; vehicle_class becomes Classic Space long-range patrol cruiser variant.

CLASSIC LEGO SPACE SPACE-STATION — yellow-torso crew on orbital-ring platform, trans-blue viewport panels, docking-arm and solar-array structural motifs; vehicle_class becomes Classic Space orbital-station or shuttle-docking variant.

TINTIN DESTINATION MOON (1953) — red-and-white checkered retro rocket, bubble-helmet astronauts, 1950s Hergé-comic palette, analogue-gauge instrument panels; vehicle_class becomes Tintin retro-lander or checkered-tower launchpad.

CLASSIC LEGO SPACE LUNAR BASE COMMAND (1979-1983) — yellow-torso crew at a moonbase command post, trans-blue dome cluster, light-bley lunar terrain, airlock-corridor hub; vehicle_class becomes Classic Space lunar-lander with fold-out access ramp.

APOLLO-ERA NASA HISTORICAL — pure-white Apollo-era spacesuits with gold-foil reflective heat-shielding, launch-team in white flight-overalls and skinny ties, Saturn-V gantry backdrop; vehicle_class becomes Apollo command-module stack.

ICE PLANET 2002 ADVANCED OUTPOST — white-and-orange crew with larger ice-drill rigs, trans-orange crystal cluster terrain, baseplate snowfield; vehicle_class becomes Ice Planet heavy ice-drill crawler with outrigger stabilizer legs.

M-TRON HEAVY FREIGHT DIVISION — red-and-black freight-crew suits, oversized magnet-crane boom, stacked cargo-pod train, lime-green coupling lights on every module; vehicle_class becomes M-Tron magnet-freight hauler with multi-pod consist.

SPACE POLICE II (1992-1993) — white-and-black updated cop uniforms, trans-yellow visor variant, prisoner-pod cage on rear fuselage, updated pursuit-cruiser silhouette; vehicle_class becomes Space Police II patrol-cruiser with cage-pod hardpoint.

FOUNDATION IMPERIAL GENETIC DYNASTY — Empire-purple imperial-officer attire, ornate gold-trim galactic-imperial uniforms, Cleon-dynasty throne-room staging, ceremonial staff props; vehicle_class becomes ornate imperial Foundation-cruiser with gilded hull panels.

UNITRON DEEP SURVEY VARIANT — blue-and-white survey-crew suits, long-range scanner dish mounted on survey-crawler, Classic-Space cousin aesthetic with added sensor-boom; vehicle_class becomes Unitron survey-crawler with articulated scanner mast.

INSECTOIDS HIVE COMMAND — purple-and-green hive-commander attire with larger carapace shoulder-armour, queen-chamber organic-throne prop, bio-luminescent trans-purple lighting; vehicle_class becomes Insectoids hive-carrier with organic ribbed-hull panelling.

TINTIN DESTINATION MOON VARIANT — bone-white bubble-helmet astronauts with retro-1950s utility belts, Hergé comic-panel flat-colour staging, moon-rover with springy antenna; vehicle_class becomes Tintin retro-moon-rover with red-white striped chassis.

CLASSIC LEGO SPACE (1978-1987) PATROL WING — yellow-torso two-pilot crew, trans-blue dual-canopy fighter, white wing-panel livery, friendly-explorer insignia on fuselage; vehicle_class becomes Classic Space patrol-wing fighter with twin-engine nacelle mount.

FOUNDATION IMPERIAL GENETIC DYNASTY (ASIMOV-APPLE) — Empire-purple imperial-officer attire, ornate galactic-imperial uniforms with gold trim, Cleon-dynasty ceremonial hardware; vehicle_class becomes Foundation imperial-palace cruiser with columned hull facade.

ICE PLANET 2002 DEEP-STATION VARIANT (1993) — white-and-orange crew inside ice-carved subterranean station, trans-orange beacon lighting, ice-saw-blade wall-cutting equipment; vehicle_class becomes Ice Planet ice-drill crawler docked at cavern base.

TINTIN DESTINATION MOON HERGÉ VARIANT — bone-white bubble-helmet suits with red-and-white checkered rocket markings, Professor Calculus instrument-panel props, 1953 retro-science aesthetic; vehicle_class becomes Tintin single-stage retro-lander on lunar surface.

CLASSIC LEGO SPACE DEEP PATROL (1980s) — yellow-torso patrol crew with extended-mission backpack gear, long-range antenna arrays, deep-space exploration equipment; vehicle_class becomes Classic Space deep-patrol scout variant.
